"""Turn a title into a lowercase, hyphen-separated URL slug."""

import re
import unicodedata

# Letters that NFKD does not decompose into ASCII, mapped to their usual spellings.
_TRANSLITERATIONS = {
    "ß": "ss",
    "æ": "ae",
    "Æ": "AE",
    "ø": "o",
    "Ø": "O",
    "ł": "l",
    "Ł": "L",
}


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Return a URL slug for ``title``.

    Special letters such as ``ß`` and ``æ`` are transliterated, other accents
    are stripped, letters and digits are lowercased, and every run of other
    characters becomes a single hyphen. Leading and trailing hyphens are
    removed.

    An empty or whitespace-only title returns ``"untitled"``. Raises
    ``ValueError`` if a non-blank title has no usable Latin letters or digits,
    for example one written entirely in non-Latin script, so that an empty slug
    is never returned silently.

    >>> slugify("Hello, World!")
    'hello-world'
    """
    if not title.strip():
        return "untitled"
    for char, replacement in _TRANSLITERATIONS.items():
        title = title.replace(char, replacement)
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    ascii_text = normalized.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    lowered = ascii_text.lower()
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lowered).strip("-")
    if not slug:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot make a slug from {title!r}")
    return slug

3	from slugify import slugify
4	
5	
6	class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
7	    def test_basic_title_becomes_hyphenated_lowercase(self):
8	        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
9	
10	    def test_punctuation_collapses_to_single_hyphen(self):
11	        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello,   World!!  Again"), "hello-world-again")
12	
13	    def test_leading_and_trailing_punctuation_is_removed(self):
14	        self.assertEqual(slugify("  --Hello World?!  "), "hello-world")
15	
16	    def test_accents_are_stripped(self):
17	        self.assertEqual(slugify("Crème Brûlée"), "creme-brulee")
18	
19	    def test_digits_are_kept(self):
20	        self.assertEqual(slugify("Top 10 Tips for 2026"), "top-10-tips-for-2026")
21	
22	    def test_german_and_nordic_letters_are_transliterated(self):
23	        self.assertEqual(slugify("Straße"), "strasse")
24	        self.assertEqual(slugify("Ærø Łódź"), "aero-lodz")
25	
26	    def test_title_with_no_latin_letters_raises(self):
27	        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
28	            slugify("你好世界")
29	
30	    def test_empty_title_gives_untitled(self):
31	        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "untitled")
32	        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "untitled")
33

36	    unittest.main()
